source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of red flags (PDF 186).

blocks.text: Red flags (khatre ki nishaniyan) woh alamaat hain jo batati hain ke source shayad qabil-e-aitbaar nahi. In mein shamil hain: author (likhne wale) ki maloomat na hona, sensational (sansani phailane wali) headlines, ya aise sources jo apne references (hawale) nahi dete.
Misal: Jis website par likhne wale ka wazeh naam ya rabte ki maloomat na ho, woh na-qabil-e-aitbaar ho sakti hai.

blocks.explanation: Author ki maloomat na hona, sansani khez headlines, aur references (hawale) na dena.

items: Red flags: author ka pata nahi, sansani khez headlines, references nahi.
